issues.message: Potential XSS vulnerability: User input not sanitized before rendering in search results
Missing error handling for search API call
Inefficient search algorithm - O(n) linear search

recommendations: Add unit tests for TodoSearch component - test user input handling and results display
Add unit tests for searchService - test search algorithm with various input cases
Add integration tests for search functionality
Add edge case tests - test with empty todos list and malformed data

suggestions.description: Extract search result rendering logic from TodoSearch component into separate SearchResults component.
Implement debouncing pattern for search input to avoid excessive API calls.

summary: Code quality score of 78/100 indicates room for improvement. Critical security issue: XSS vulnerability in search results rendering. Test coverage at 62% is below recommended threshold. Recommend addressing high-severity issues before merging.
